THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.0-: What do you seek in this tower?
Magic I haven't seen before. And a way out.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.1-: You again. Have you not learned to give up?
I still haven't figured out the magic you used last time.
I am under no obligation to teach you.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.2-: I see. I'm beginning to understand your magic.
At least I'll know more when I come back.
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.title: Serie
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
Between the stacks of books, a golden-haired elf looks up.

"...You again, Frieren."
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.pages.DONE.description:
Serie opens her book again.

"Next time, at least bring some worthwhile magic."

"That depends on what I find," you reply.
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN: ...Frieren. The ban is still in effect. Who let you in?
Continue
This is the Spire, not the Association.
Continue
Still looking for loopholes, I see. Have you climbed all this way to ask for my instruction?
Continue
I thought I would look around. There might be some magic worth taking home.
Continue
I have no intention of collecting trivial tricks for you. ...Choose one of these and be on your way.
Continue
Then I will take you up on that.
That expression. Have you found another useless spell?
Continue
One that keeps flowers blooming a few days longer. It will be useful on our travels.
Continue
A few days? All that effort for so little time. You have not changed at all.
Continue
A few days is a long time for the people who get to see them.
Continue
...Do as you like. The gifts are over there. Leave my books alone.
That bed looks comfortable.
Continue
These are for those fit to climb higher, and you are already thinking of sleep.
Continue
We can travel farther after a good rest.
Continue
Flamme certainly did not teach you that excuse.
Continue
No. I learned that one myself.
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: If you intend to climb higher, show that you have the strength to survive. Choose one.
